body:
Profile and handbook inspection appeared only as underlying screen views. This change adds fixed profile-type open/close and handbook lifecycle/section targets to the existing count-only usage contract. Shared handlers count successful visible inspections, deduplicate refreshes/selections/closes, and exclude failed, cancelled or stale opens. Targets contain no profile identity or private content; navigation adds no accepted campaign decisions.

Integrated authoritative main `300462da2ae10a55c6106918c9de209638f85406` into original reviewed head `5b583f60980690d64c4eaa0c816291b94ab9ed1f`. Current head: `d67f5a24a17128921523d42b05cff0a822b1aa54`. The six source/test feature paths retain the exact original added/deleted lines, including Market-search compatibility and mixed-batch regression.

Qualification: all 926 published main playtest blobs and canonical 765 rows (SHA256 `bb487d17e5f50c0c53e3b7ced193bae5ba785313413f39fdbbe17ec5c6783b4c`) remain exact. Eighteen history conflicts were newline-equivalent. Root reviewed the one README reverse-prefix difference; main bytes are authoritative and the original full README is archived exactly. Prior integration artifacts remain exact, and changed historical source references have an exact old-head Git archive.

No local tests, expensive gates or fresh browser acceptance were launched for this integration, as requested. Historical native results (1262 and 1285 passed), browser receipts and old-head CI apply only to their original source. Fresh CI for the current integrated head is pending; no current validation is inherited.

Evidence: `docs/playtests/integration-pr369/README.md`, `source-and-history-qualification.json` (complete current src/tests/data/scripts raw/Git manifests and conflict/history proofs), `historical-original/README.md`, and `historical-changed-source.zip`. Original browser/native artifacts remain in `docs/playtests/2026-10-10-overlay-usage/` and its `integration/` folder.
